praises: 1TB at the same sale price as the 512GB Ultra 7 tier — the obvious value pick of the Book6 14 range
Ultra 7 Lunar Lake with Arc 140V handles light gaming and 4K video editing for an iGPU machine
~1.13 kg with ~12h real battery — a true travel ultrabook
Galaxy ecosystem: Quick Share, Second Screen, Side Sync with Galaxy phones
Copilot+ NPU qualifies for on-device Copilot features
complaints: Still the dim ~300-nit glossy FHD+ IPS panel at $1,900 — the Pro tier's AMOLED is where the pretty screen lives
Occasional coil-whine reports on the bundled charger (line-wide complaint)

design_philosophy: The 1TB Ultra 7 tier is the fully-loaded version of Samsung's volume 14-inch Copilot+ chassis. With double the storage at the same sale price as the 512GB twin, it is the configuration the line was designed to be: Lunar Lake efficiency, sub-1.2 kg, Galaxy-phone parity features, and enough SSD that the soldered-RAM compromise stings less.
